# AI Guide (aiguide.co.za)

> The practical AI guide for South African business, written by Chad Etkind and Adam Sacharowitz, the engineers behind Zaiq (https://zaiq.co.za). Plain-English, rand-priced, POPIA-aware answers about what AI actually does for an SA business, what digital work costs, and how to get found by AI search. No hype.

## Start here
- [AI for South African business: the practical 2026 guide](https://aiguide.co.za/guides/ai-for-south-african-business): The main hub — what AI does for an SA business, where to start, what works.
- [What digital work costs in South Africa (2026)](https://aiguide.co.za/guides/what-digital-work-costs-south-africa): One honest rand reference for websites, SEO, ads, apps, CRM, and POS.
- [Automate your South African business: what to fix first](https://aiguide.co.za/guides/automate-your-south-african-business): What to automate first and the typical rand cost of each fix.

## AI, POPIA and data safety
- [Can you put customer data into ChatGPT in South Africa?](https://aiguide.co.za/guides/can-you-put-customer-data-in-chatgpt-south-africa): Whether it is allowed under POPIA, and the safe ways to use AI.
- [POPIA-compliant AI tools for South African business](https://aiguide.co.za/guides/popia-compliant-ai-tools-south-africa): What makes an AI tool POPIA-compliant and the realistic options.
- [Is it legal to use AI for SARS and tax data in South Africa?](https://aiguide.co.za/guides/is-it-legal-to-use-ai-for-sars-tax-data-south-africa): POPIA, the Tax Administration Act, and professional confidentiality.
- [How to anonymise data before using AI](https://aiguide.co.za/guides/how-to-anonymise-data-before-using-ai): Step-by-step de-identification so data falls outside POPIA.
- [AI and POPIA: is your data safe with AI tools?](https://aiguide.co.za/guides/ai-popia-data-safety): What the law requires and the practical rules.
